eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Lincoln, NM; at 3:47 PM on SEP 17, 2026 Effective until 7:47 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Lincoln County OES. Flash Flooding OBSERVED in Ruidoso Downs. MOVE to higher ground. Lincoln County Emergency Management: Flash Flood Alert for Ruidoso Downs along Rio Ruidoso. Rapidly rising floodwaters may impact roadways and low-lying areas. Avoid travel and move to higher ground if threatened. Do NOT drive through flooded roads. Personnel needing shelter can go to the Ruidoso Downs Senior Center.
